name: Topology of Exact Coefficient Reduction
statement: The exact reduction projection $\mathcal A(C)\to E_K$ is a homotopy equivalence with a continuous section, and every nonempty fiber is contractible. If all terminal local systems clear, the full coefficient space and every prescribed-row extension fiber are contractible.
proof: Minimum-norm witnesses vary continuously. Each unique-occurrence row deletion has an explicit continuous section and two convex interpolation homotopies; unused simplex factors contract linearly. Compose these maps through the reduction.
